description: Meet John. John Conyers, III (JC3) is a lifelong Detroiter running for State Senate to make Michigan more affordable, grow the economy in a way that lasts, and restore trust in government. John's experiences growing up taught him early on that the difference between getting ahead and falling behind is often access, not effort. He is the child of an incarcerated parent.
